run_summary: The Japan Meteorological Agency has issued a Level 5 Flood Emergency Warning for the Shonai River in Aichi and Gifu prefectures, indicating an imminent risk of flooding. Travelers in these areas should prioritize safety and follow local evacuation instructions.

candidates.title: Flood Emergency Warning Issued for Shonai River (Aichi/Gifu)
candidates.formal_status_basis: JMA issued a Level 5 Flood Emergency Warning (氾濫特別警報) for the Shonai River.
candidates.what_changed: The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) has issued a Level 5 Flood Emergency Warning for the Shonai River, the highest level of alert.
candidates.why_it_matters: There is an imminent risk of river flooding, which poses a severe threat to life and property in the immediate vicinity. Transport services in the area may be suspended or disrupted.
candidates.traveler_action: Avoid the vicinity of the Shonai River. Follow all evacuation orders from local municipal authorities. Check real-time transport updates if traveling through Aichi or Gifu.
